measures.name: R14 OH EUR
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Total Ext Cost IC], TREATAS({2}, 'Selected Currency Filter'[Selected Currency]))

measures.name: R14 Inventory Date
measures.expression:
VAR q = [Qty On Hand]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(q), SELECTEDVALUE('Calendar Inventory Snapshot'[Calendar Date]))

measures.name: R14 Last Refreshed
measures.expression: "As of " & FORMAT(MAX('Calendar Inventory Snapshot'[Calendar Date]), "MMM d, yyyy")
